οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἴχεται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. with perf. sense, 3 sg.: ’is gone’

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔατος: οὖς — ear; neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὠτός)
οὔτασε: οὐτάω — wound (by a thrust), stab; aor. 3 sg. act.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάννυχοι: πάννυχος — all night long; adj., masc. nom. pl.: ’through the night’
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
παπτήνας: παπταίνω — look about, glance around; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having looked about’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατροκλῆος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έους)
πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
παῦσε: παύω — make cease, stop (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔπαυσε): ’made cease’
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’
πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πεσέεσθαι: πίπτω — fall; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεσεῖσθαι): ’to fall (upon)’
πηλεΐδῃ: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. dat. sg.
πηνέλεως: Πηνέλεως — Peneleos, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
πιστὸν: πιστός — faithful, trusty; masc. acc. sg.
ποδώκεας: ποδώκης — fleet-footed; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl., epic -εας (= Attic -εις), agreeing with the mares
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πουλυδάμαντος: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. gen. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντος)
πρήσσει: πρήσσω — do, accomplish, get done; pres. 3 sg., Ionic -ήσσ- (= Attic πράττει): οὔ τι πρήσσει ’accomplishes nothing’
προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’much, greatly’ (πόλλ’ ἀεκαζομένη ’much against her will’)
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἣ (the head): ’all of it’ (ἣ … πᾶσα ’the whole of it’)
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.: οὐδέ πῃ ’not in any way’
πῖαρ: πῖαρ — fat, richness; neut. acc. sg. as a noun, object of ἑλέσθαι: ’fat flesh’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σχήσεσθ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. hold oneself back; fut. inf. mid., elided (σχήσεσθ’ = σχήσεσθαι): ’to hold back’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάμε: τέμνω — cut; aor. 3 sg. act., epic stem ταμ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἔτεμε): ’cut’
τάς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl., used as relative with τε: ’which’
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated · also accented before the enclitic με (ὅς τέ με), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated

τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τετιηότι: τετίημαι — be grieved, be downcast (perf. with pres. force); perf. part. act. masc. dat. sg., epic -ηότι: ’grieved’
τετραμμένος: τρέπω — turn; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned himself’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., predicate with ἐόντα: ’being such a man’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’
τρέσσε: τρέω — flee in fear, shrink back; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔτρεσε), unaugmented: ’shrank back’
τρεῖ: τρέω — tremble, shrink from, fear; pres. 3 sg., + acc.: ’shrinks from’
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φίλτατος: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’dearest’
φασὶν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl. (ν-movable), accented from the enclitic
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., after μνήσαντο: ’remembered flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., of respect after ἀδήριτος: ’in flight’ (ἤτ’ ἀλκῆς ἤτε φόβοιο)
χάρμα: χάρμα — joy, delight, source of joy; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition · also neut. acc. sg., predicate after γενέσθαι: ’a joy’
χάρμης: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. gen. sg.
χέοντα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’shedding’
χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic χερσί), instrumental: ’with the hands’ · also with ἐν, locative: ’in the hands’ · also fem. dat. pl., object of πεποιθότες: ’in their hands’ (χείρεσσι πεποιθότες ’trusting in their hands’)

χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
ἀΐσσουσι: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, spring; pres. 3 pl. (Attic ᾄττω): ’dart, fly’
ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
ἀέκων: ἀέκων — unwilling, against one’s will; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄκων): ’unwillingly’
ἀγαθός: ἀγαθός — good, brave; masc. nom. sg.

ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤλεθ: ὄλλυμι (mid. ὄλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλεθ’ = ὤλετο): ’he perished’
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed, lost’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
